info.name: Karsaaz ERP Chat Bridge
info.summary: Webhook integration — embed Karsaaz Cloud chat in any external ERP
info.description: Allows external ERP systems to embed Nextcloud Talk chat into their own UI via a webhook registration + JWT auth delegation model. The ERP owns authentication and (optionally) the message database; Karsaaz Cloud owns the chat backend and view.
info.author: Karsaaz
